Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: Show the exact S1-S5 execute slot when a CC enemy drops below 50% HP.
Description: A display-only Ninja PvP overlay that maps the game's real enemy slots <e1>-<e5> to S1-S5, shows the matching slot above enemies below Seiton Tenchu's HP threshold, and flashes once on entry.
